```markdown
# Data Binding Contract

## Propósito

Resolver datos externos hacia valores canónicos de schemas mediante configuración
serializable y portable.

## DataPointer

Soportar como mínimo:

``​`ts
type DataPointer =
  | {
      syntax: 'json-pointer';
      path: string;
    }
  | {
      syntax: 'jsonpath';
      expression: string;
      cardinality?: 'one' | 'first' | 'many';
    };
``​`

No usar un parser ad hoc de `a.b[0].c` como única sintaxis.

## Resultado tipado

``​`ts
type ResolvedData =
  | { kind: 'missing' }
  | { kind: 'scalar'; value: string | number | boolean | null }
  | { kind: 'object'; value: Record<string, unknown> }
  | { kind: 'array'; value: unknown[] };
``​`

Los bindings declaran `expect: scalar | object | array | any`.

## Option source

``​`ts
type OptionValue = string | number | boolean | null;

type OptionItem = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  value: OptionValue;
  disabled?: boolean;
  description?: string;
  iconUrl?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
};
``​`

Compatibilidad con `string[]` existente mediante adapter/migration.

## Selected value fuera de la página actual

No inferir que el valor dejó de existir.

Política:

``​`text
keep-stale
invalidate
clear
``​`

Default recomendado: `keep-stale`.

No seleccionar `options[0]` silenciosamente por no encontrar el valor en la ventana actual.

## Binding por familia

La metadata del registry/plugin declara si soporta:

``​`text
none
scalar
collection
artifact
``​`

Ejemplos:

- text → scalar/string;
- number → scalar/number;
- date/time → scalar validado;
- select/dropdown → collection;
- radioGroup → collection;
- checkboxGroup → collection;
- table → array/object mapping;
- image → reference/artifact policy;
- barcode → scalar;
- multiVariableText → bindings múltiples;
- signature → provider/action especializado, no simple DataSource.

No duplicar `switch(schema.type)` como segunda autoridad.

## Transaction semantics

Carga remota:

``​`text
origin = prefill/system
touched = false
``​`

Interacción humana:

``​`text
origin = user
touched = true
dirty = true
``​`

Una actualización remota no sobrescribe un valor user-dirty salvo política explícita.

Preservar semántica de:

``​`text
0
false
[]
null
""
undefined
``​`

según `SchemaValueCodec`.

## Snapshot

Persistir valor canónico y, cuando haga falta para representación determinista:

``​`json
{
  "value": 25,
  "displayValue": "Elemento 25"
}
``​`

No persistir por defecto la respuesta API completa.

Viewer/Generator/PDF no reconsultan la API por defecto.
```

```markdown
# Data Source Contract

## Propósito

Una fuente de datos es una abstracción reusable que obtiene o busca datos para un
schema sin colocar HTTP dentro del plugin del schema.

PokeAPI, catálogos empresariales, países, clientes, empleados, productos y servicios
internos son consumidores equivalentes de este contrato.

## Formas soportadas

### Provider programático

Para APIs complejas:

``​`ts
export interface DataSourceProvider {
  query(request: DataSourceQuery): Promise<DataSourceResult>;
  resolveByValue?(request: ResolveDataSourceValue): Promise<DataSourceItem | null>;
}
``​`

### HTTP declarativo

Para APIs convencionales:

``​`ts
type HttpDataSourceDefinition = {
  key: string;
  request: {
    method: string;
    path: string;
    query?: Record<string, DataReference>;
    body?: unknown;
  };
  response: DataResponseMapping;
  search?: DataSourceSearchPolicy;
  paging?: DataSourcePagingPolicy;
};
``​`

El descriptor HTTP utiliza el `HttpClientAdapter` inyectado. Nunca crea un cliente Axios
propio por schema.

## Registry

`sourceKey` es la referencia estable:

``​`json
{
  "optionSource": {
    "kind": "resource",
    "sourceKey": "customerCatalog"
  }
}
``​`

El template no necesita conocer:

- token;
- Redux;
- base URL secreta;
- interceptor;
- refresh token;
- certificado;
- implementación HTTP.

## Query

Contexto mínimo:

``​`ts
type DataSourceQuery = {
  sourceKey: string;
  search?: string;
  offset?: number;
  cursor?: unknown;
  limit?: number;
  params?: Record<string, unknown>;
  userId?: string;
  documentId?: string;
  runtimeSessionId?: string;
  signal: AbortSignal;
};
``​`

Los campos de identidad sólo existen para aislamiento/capability; no deben transportar
reglas de negocio de un host.

## Result

``​`ts
type DataSourceResult = {
  items: DataSourceItem[];
  nextCursor?: unknown;
  total?: number;
  rawMeta?: Record<string, unknown>;
};
``​`

`rawMeta` no implica persistir la respuesta completa.

## Búsqueda y paginación

Soportar:

- none;
- client search;
- remote search;
- offset;
- cursor.

`visibleRows` es presentación y no equivale a `pageSize`.

## Concurrencia

Obligatorio:

- debounce configurable;
- AbortController;
- request sequence;
- ignorar respuestas stale;
- single-flight para queries idénticas;
- cache policy;
- TTL opcional;
- cleanup.

## Cache key

Debe considerar según corresponda:

``​`text
sourceKey
× query
× page/cursor
× params
× dependency values
× User
× document
× runtime session
``​`

No mezclar datos privados de dos Users.

## Dependencies

Una source puede depender de valores de otros schemas:

``​`text
countryId
→ city source params
→ city options
``​`

Al cambiar una dependencia:

1. abortar request anterior;
2. recalcular params;
3. preservar o invalidar selección según política declarada;
4. no marcar touched sólo por recargar opciones.

## Error model

Estados mínimos:

``​`text
idle
loading
success
empty
error
cancelled
stale
``​`

El usuario puede reintentar cuando la política lo permita.

## Fixture público

PokeAPI puede usarse exclusivamente bajo `examples/tests` para demostrar:

- objeto;
- array;
- paginación;
- mapping;
- búsqueda simulada/adaptada.

Nunca introducir `pokemon` en el core.
```

```markdown
# Font Registry Contract

## Propósito

Usar una autoridad de fuentes compartida por schemas textuales, firma e iniciales.

## Descriptor

``​`ts
type FontDescriptor = {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  cssFamily: string;
  pdfFontName?: string;
  source: 'system' | 'bundled' | 'host';
  category?: 'sans' | 'serif' | 'handwriting' | 'monospace' | 'display';
};
``​`

La implementación final puede extender este contrato sin crear registries paralelos.

## Firma e iniciales

`SignatureStyleDefinition` referencia `fontKey` y conserva:

- styleId;
- fontStyle;
- fontWeight;
- skewDeg;
- letterSpacing.

Firma e iniciales adoptadas por la misma identidad usan el mismo `styleId`.

No mutar la receta histórica de un `styleId` ya persistido. Nuevos estilos usan IDs nuevos.

## Loading

Antes de rasterizar una firma:

``​`text
ensureFontLoaded
→ ready
→ preview
→ artifact
``​`

No rasterizar silenciosamente un fallback y cambiar luego de apariencia.

## Paridad

``​`text
Designer/Form preview
=
Viewer
=
Generated PDF
``​`

Una fuente disponible sólo en CSS no cuenta como paridad PDF.

## Recursos host

Fuentes host-provided se inyectan como runtime resources. No guardar bytes de fuentes en
el schema JSON.
```

```markdown
# Host execution context

## Purpose

Define the generic unit of Form execution without encoding a business workflow.

## Isolation identity

Runtime state is scoped by:

``​`text
runtimeSession × user × document
``​`

A switch of any identity dimension must not leak:

- values;
- touched/dirty state;
- completion;
- signatures/initials;
- attachments/artifacts;
- remote option caches;
- in-flight responses;
- local drafts.

## Runtime input

``​`text
User
Document
serializable inputs
access projection
signature context
integration resources
opaque session scope
``​`

## Out of scope

The reusable does not determine:

- who executes next;
- whether execution is sequential or parallel;
- how many host requests are created;
- when a business process is complete;
- how the host persists its relational projection.

The same generic Form must support all host orchestration shapes by receiving the already
resolved execution context.
```

```markdown
# Host independence contract

## Invariant

SISAD-PDFME must remain usable by an arbitrary consumer without importing business
concepts from that consumer.

## Allowed host input

A host may provide:

``​`ts
type HostRuntimeProjection = {
  user?: UserResource | null;
  document?: DocumentResource | null;
  inputs?: unknown[];
  access?: SchemaAccessProjection;
  resources?: IntegrationResources;
  signatureContext?: SignatureRuntimeContext;
  runtimeSessionId?: string | null;
  hostReference?: string | null;
};
``​`

`hostReference` is opaque. The reusable never interprets it as routing, request state or a
business entity identifier.

## Forbidden core semantics

Do not add host-specific:

- workflow/routing modes;
- stages/positions;
- request status;
- notification policy;
- backend entity names;
- endpoint names;
- persistence table/DTO names.

## Consumer adapter

The adapter belongs to the consuming application.

``​`text
consumer model
    ↓
consumer-owned adapter
    ↓
public SISAD-PDFME contracts
``​`

## Gate

A portable consumer smoke must use public exports only. Deep imports from Canvas, Moveable,
Selecto, internal registries, private runtime stores or schema implementation files fail
the gate.
```

### 0880 — `.ai/brain/20-contracts/integration/HOST-PARTICIPANT-USER-BOUNDARY.md`

```markdown
# Host participant / SISAD-PDFME user boundary

## Canon

SISAD-PDFME is a standalone reusable document platform. It does not know the business
entities, routing model, request model, notification model or persistence model of any host.

A host may have any external actor representation:
- person;
- signer;
- approver;
- reviewer;
- customer;
- employee;
- workflow actor;
- anonymous/session actor.

The host adapts that entity into a `SisadPdfmeUser`.

## Canonical SISAD-PDFME concept

``​`ts
type SisadPdfmeUser = {
  id: string;
  displayName: string;
  color?: string;
  role?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  capabilities?: {
    canEdit?: boolean;
    canSign?: boolean;
    canApprove?: boolean;
    canComment?: boolean;
    canEditStructure?: boolean;
  };
  hostReference?: {
    type: string;
    id: string;
  };
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
};
``​`

`hostReference` is opaque. Core logic must not branch on its `type`.

## Internal identities

- active user: actor operating this runtime instance;
- assigned user: actor authorized/expected to interact with a schema;
- audit user: actor that created, changed or locked an object.

These identities may coincide but are not the same responsibility.

## Forbidden host leakage

Core must not require host concepts such as:
- routing order/stages;
- request/envelope state;
- notifications/channels;
- batch membership;
- backend identifiers unrelated to document interaction;
- host API DTOs.

## Identity terminology

The core exposes one current identity vocabulary. Do not add aliases or bridges
solely to preserve historical `Recipient*` or `activeRecipientId` names. Host
translation, when genuinely required by an external boundary, belongs in the
host adapter and must not leak an alternate model into core state.
```

### 0881 — `.ai/brain/20-contracts/integration/HTTP-CLIENT-CONTRACT.md`

- **Lenguaje:** `markdown`
- **Líneas:** `187`
- **Tamaño original:** `4.4 KB`
- **SHA1 corto:** `d35983590d`
- **Estado:** `completo`

```markdown
# HTTP Client Contract

## Propósito

SISAD-PDFME puede consumir recursos remotos sin acoplarse a Axios, fetch, Redux,
cookies, un backend concreto o una aplicación host.

## Autoridad

El core depende de un contrato estructural:

``​`ts
export type HttpRequest = {
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE' | 'HEAD';
  url: string;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  query?: Record<string, unknown>;
  body?: unknown;
  timeoutMs?: number;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  responseType?: 'json' | 'text' | 'arrayBuffer' | 'blob';
};

export type HttpResponse<T = unknown> = {
  status: number;
  headers: Record<string, string>;
  data: T;
};

export interface HttpClientAdapter {
  request<T = unknown>(request: HttpRequest): Promise<HttpResponse<T>>;
}
``​`

No se requiere que el contrato anterior sea idéntico en nombre si live source ya posee
una abstracción equivalente. Debe existir una sola autoridad.

## Inyección desde el host

La frontera pública debe aceptar runtime resources no serializables:

``​`ts
resources: {
  integrations: {
    httpClient,
    dataSources,
    signatureExecution,
    fonts
  }
}
``​`

La forma exacta debe reconciliarse con `SisadPdfmeInstanceResources`; no crear una
segunda raíz si `adapters` o `resources` ya resuelven el mismo problema.

## Axios

Axios es una integración opcional, no dependencia del core.

Patrón recomendado:

``​`ts
const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: env.API_URL
});

api.interceptors.request.use((config) => {
  const token = [REDACTED];
  if (token) config.headers.Authorization = `[REDACTED]}`;
  return config;
});

const httpClient = createAxiosHttpClientAdapter(api);
``​`

Al reutilizar `api`, SISAD-PDFME hereda la conducta configurada por el host mediante
el adapter, sin conocer cómo se obtiene el token.

También puede existir una factory que reciba una configuración Axios, siempre fuera
del template/snapshot y sin hacer de Axios una dependencia obligatoria del core.

## Fetch u otros clientes

Debe poder existir una implementación equivalente:

``​`ts
const httpClient = createFetchHttpClientAdapter({
  fetch: window.fetch.bind(window),
  baseUrl,
  resolveHeaders
});
``​`

Cualquier cliente futuro puede participar si implementa `HttpClientAdapter`.

## Authorization y headers

Modos conceptuales:

- `client`: el cliente inyectado resuelve defaults/interceptors;
- `resolver`: el host entrega headers dinámicos por request;
- `none`: no se inyectan credenciales;
- `provider`: un DataSource/Signature provider resuelve su propia autenticación.

No leer tokens directamente desde Redux/localStorage dentro de SISAD-PDFME.

Ejemplo:

``​`ts
resolveHeaders: async (context) => {
  const token = [REDACTED];
  return token ? { Authorization: `[REDACTED]}` } : {};
}
``​`

## Seguridad de headers sensibles

Authorization, Cookie, Proxy-Authorization y secretos equivalentes no se deben reenviar
automáticamente a cualquier origen.

Default seguro:

``​`text
same origin
OR explicit allowed origin
=> sensitive headers pueden enviarse

otro origen
=> sensitive headers bloqueados
``​`

Una source remota no puede desactivar esta regla desde un template no confiable.

## Precedencia

La precedencia debe ser única y documentada. Recomendación:

1. defaults/interceptors del cliente host;
2. configuración runtime del transport;
3. headers estáticos no sensibles de DataSource;
4. `resolveHeaders(context)`;
5. headers técnicos generados por el provider.

Conflictos de headers sensibles deben seguir política explícita, no merge silencioso.

## Lifecycle

Todo request debe soportar cuando aplique:

- AbortSignal;
- timeout;
- correlación;
- tamaño máximo;
- tipos de contenido permitidos;
- logging seguro;
- retry sólo cuando sea semánticamente seguro;
- cleanup al desmontar/cambiar session/document/User.

## Persistencia

No serializar:

- cliente HTTP;
- instancia Axios;
- interceptors;
- funciones;
- Authorization;
- cookies;
- API keys;
- client secrets.

El patrón actual donde el bundle elimina adapters no serializables debe extenderse a
los integration runtime resources equivalentes.

## Tests mínimos

- cliente Axios-like inyectado;
- cliente fetch-like inyectado;
- Authorization mediante interceptor;
- Authorization mediante resolver;
- no Authorization cross-origin no permitido;
- AbortSignal;
- timeout;
- request concurrente;
- response JSON/text/binary;
- adapter ausente;
- snapshot/bundle sin secretos ni funciones.
```

### 0882 — `.ai/brain/20-contracts/integration/INTEGRATION-RUNTIME-CONTRACT.md`

- **Lenguaje:** `markdown`

- **SHA1 corto:** `3472138bbf`

```markdown
# Integration Runtime Contract

## Propósito

Unificar lifecycle técnico compartido por integraciones sin convertir todas las
integraciones en un único `executeAnyApi`.

## Capas

``​`text
IntegrationRuntime
├── HttpClientAdapter
├── DataSourceProvider
├── ActionProvider
├── SignatureProvider
└── FontProvider
``​`

Cada provider conserva su semántica.

## Lifecycle compartido

``​`text
idle
pending
success
error
cancelled
``​`

Servicios comunes:

- AbortSignal;
- timeout;
- correlationId;
- logging seguro;
- metrics;
- retry policy;
- cleanup;
- cache sólo donde sea correcto.

## DataSource vs Action vs Signature

`DataSourceProvider`:
- lectura/búsqueda/paginación;
- normalmente idempotente.

`ActionProvider`:
- side effect;
- requiere política explícita de retry/idempotency.

`SignatureProvider`:
- ceremonia especializada;
- puede usar polling, webhook, OTP, biometría, certificados y artifacts.

Una firma externa no debe modelarse como un select remoto ni como un `fetch` dentro
de `signature/index.ts`.

## Portabilidad

Los providers runtime son recursos inyectados, no contenido durable del template.

El componente debe poder copiarse a otro proyecto y registrar allí:

- su Axios instance;
- su fetch wrapper;
- su auth resolver;
- sus DataSources;
- sus SignatureProviders;
- sus fonts.

## Fallo de integración

Una integración caída no debe:

- corromper otros schemas;
- revertir drafts hermanos;
- contaminar otro User/document/session;
- producir un PDF inconsistente;
- convertir automáticamente `pending` en complete.

## Observabilidad

No loggear secretos.

Los eventos pueden incluir:

``​`text
providerKey
operation
correlationId
duration
status
errorCode seguro
``​`

No incluir tokens/cookies/certificados privados.
```

### 0883 — `.ai/brain/20-contracts/integration/README.md`

```markdown
# Agent claim contract

Claim record:

``​`ts
type AgentClaim = {
  agent: 'claude' | 'codex' | 'copilot' | string;
  task: string;
  mode: 'write' | 'review';
  paths: string[];
  startedAt: string;
  note?: string;
};
``​`

Claims live in `.ai/ops/coordination/claims.json`.

The helper script serializes changes to the registry with a filesystem lock.

A writer:
1. claims;
2. re-reads the claimed files;
3. edits;
4. runs focal gates;
5. writes evidence/handoff;
6. releases.

Never treat a stale diff as permission to overwrite it.
```

```markdown
# AI structure contract

## Invariants

- One active authority per concept.
- Generated inventories live under `.ai/index/`.
- Historical provenance lives under `.ai/archive/`.
- Task state lives in task-card + evidence; views are projections.
- Brain contains durable knowledge, not source snapshots that silently rot.
- Every active Markdown must be reachable from `.ai/README.md` through README hubs.
- Exact duplicate content in active knowledge is a validation failure unless explicitly exempt.
- Deletion requires external backup and reference rewrite.
```

```markdown
# Archive and residue contract

Before deletion classify:

- transient — recreable scratch data;
- generated — regenerable projection/index;
- historical — Git history is the record; do not copy into the active tree;
- provider-adapter — current host boundary only, never a historical compatibility surface;
- canonical — source of truth;
- unknown — do not touch automatically.

Rules:

- `.trace-tmp` may be removed only when the external reference scan is empty and a backup exists.
- Replaced campaign generations are deleted after unique current knowledge is migrated;
  Git retains their history.
- empty files are not automatically trash.
- duplicate provider skills are not automatically trash.
```

```markdown
# Autonomous execution contract

El agente principal funciona como coordinator continuo.

## Loop

``​`text
reconcile live state
 -> choose next unblocked task
 -> characterize
 -> implement smallest authority
 -> focal tests
 -> integration gates
 -> evidence
 -> ledger
 -> next task
``​`

No pregunta al usuario qué task continuar.

## Decision policy

Cuando hay varias soluciones válidas:
1. contrato existente;
2. menor superficie pública;
3. menor riesgo de migración;
4. reversible;
5. reusable;
6. menos duplicación.

Si una decisión cambia arquitectura pública, escribir ADR/evidence.

## Block policy

Un task bloqueado no detiene todo el programa si existe trabajo independiente.

Sólo solicitar intervención humana por:
- secreto/credencial no disponible;
- requisito externo imposible de simular;
- decisión de producto no derivable de source/contratos;
- conflicto de writers no aislable de forma segura.
```

- **Estado:** `completo`

```markdown
# Integrator lease contract

Because all agents share the same branch, commit/push is a serialized responsibility.

The integrator:
- reviews active claims;
- refuses commit while another writer reports an unfinished partial edit unless those files are
  intentionally included;
- runs `git status --short`;
- stages explicit paths;
- never uses `git add .` during concurrent operation unless all writers have reached a barrier;
- writes commit messages from task/evidence;
- pushes only after release gates required by that slice.

Default recommended integrator can be Claude or Codex; the role, not provider, is authoritative.
```

```markdown
# Memory update contract

Persist only:
- stable architecture decisions;
- proven invariants;
- completed migrations;
- verified baselines.

Do not persist:
- unverified suspected root causes;
- temporary file counts;
- transient local failures;
- provider-specific conversational memory as canonical truth.

CURRENT is a compact delta.
HANDOFF contains only what the next execution needs.
Evidence contains command output.
```

```markdown
# Production objective contract

The campaign succeeds only when all of the following are true:

- no unresolved local P0/P1;
- RTP release gates PASS with evidence;
- VISUX release gates PASS with evidence;
- all registered editable schemas have Form tests;
- all visual/computed schemas have parity tests;
- multi-user/multi-document isolation proven in browser;
- no sibling rollback;
- dynamic config/capability authority is singular;
- no direct product coupling to Axios or a concrete signature provider;
- snapshot/PDF deterministic without remote refetch;
- no sensitive secret persisted;
- no module-level mutable state that crosses instances;
- project-owned TypeScript errors reach zero, or the release is explicitly blocked;
- dead-code/duplicate/cycle ratchets do not regress;
- final Brain/current/handoff generated from live source/evidence.

"Lots of green unit tests" is not sufficient.
```

### 0895 — `.ai/brain/20-contracts/operations/SAME-REPO-MULTI-AGENT-CONTRACT.md`

- **Lenguaje:** `markdown`
- **Líneas:** `45`
- **Tamaño original:** `1.0 KB`
- **SHA1 corto:** `ed962ff3ec`
- **Estado:** `completo`

```markdown
# Same repo multi-agent contract

## Constraint

No worktrees. No branch switching. All agents operate on the current branch/worktree.

## Exclusive write ownership

Every product path being modified must be claimed.

A claim owns:
- exact files; or
- a narrowly scoped directory only when every file inside belongs to one task.

Broad claims such as `src/**` are invalid unless the coordinator explicitly serializes all
other writers.

## Git integration

Only the current `integrator` lease holder may:
- stage;
- commit;
- push;
- amend;
- resolve index conflicts.

Other agents must not manipulate the index.

## Validation barrier

Full suite/build/release evidence is valid only when:
- no conflicting writer is changing dependencies during the run;
- or the coordinator has acquired the validation lease.

## Conflict behavior

On claim collision:
- do not edit;
- do not revert;
- select a disjoint task;
- or switch to reviewer mode.

## Dirty tree

Preexisting changes are preserved. The agent records which paths it owns.
```

```markdown
# Task status authority contract

Precedence:

``​`text
explicit evidence
> task-card frontmatter
> ledger/view
> prompt/Todo/chat
``​`

Canonical states:

`BACKLOG | READY | IN_PROGRESS | REVIEW | BLOCKED | PARTIAL | PASS | ARCHIVED`

A direct PASS becomes effective `PARTIAL` when a declared dependency is not effective PASS.

This is intentional: work can be implemented/evidenced early without falsely closing the DAG.

Views never own state. Reconciliation updates cards first and regenerates views afterward.
```

- **Lenguaje:** `markdown`
- **Líneas:** `18`
- **Tamaño original:** `0.6 KB`
- **SHA1 corto:** `990b0c804e`
- **Estado:** `completo`

```markdown
# Tooling safe-apply contract

Toda herramienta que modifique filesystem usa dos fases:

``​`text
PREPARE -> plan serializable create/identical/update/conflict/skip
APPLY   -> ejecuta exactamente el plan validado
``​`

Reglas:
- dry-run por defecto;
- backup externo antes de overwrite/delete;
- keep-target por defecto en conflicto;
- no partial apply tras detectar conflicto salvo `--new-only` explícito;
- no delete de contenido divergente;
- no path traversal;
- package-script conflict se reporta, no se pisa silenciosamente;
- semantic identifier rename nunca usa global path/text replacement.
```

```markdown
# Runtime access authority contract

SISAD-PDFME must have one canonical authority for schema runtime access.

Inputs include:
- active User;
- assignment;
- explicit readonly;
- hidden;
- lock;
- capability;
- document/session context;
- value scope when applicable.

Outputs:

``​`ts
type SchemaAccessResult = {
  visible: boolean;
  editable: boolean;
  interactive: boolean;
  executable: boolean;
  reason?: string;
};
``​`

Designer, Form, completion and relevant commands must derive from the same policy/projection.

Do not keep two divergent resolvers where one has no consumers and another governs Preview.

RTP-510 cannot PASS until a `single` assignment proves:
assigned User editable;
other Users not editable according to policy.
```

```markdown
# Form completion contract

`touched`, `dirty`, `valid`, `committed` y `completed` son estados diferentes.

Completion se deriva de schema capabilities + required/access + codec/validation. El host
puede exigir un criterio de negocio superior, pero no debe inferirlo con truthiness.

Valores válidos como `0`, `false` y `[]` se evalúan con codec. Campos readonly/hidden que
no corresponden al User activo no bloquean completion salvo policy explícita.
```

```markdown
# Form runtime isolation

Mutable Form state is scoped by:

``​`text
runtimeSession
  x user
  x document
``​`

The host owns the meaning of the runtime session identifier. SISAD-PDFME treats it as opaque.

State that must never leak between scopes:
- inputs/drafts;
- touched/dirty/validation;
- signatures/initials;
- artifacts/attachments;
- transient action state;
- focus/editing state where persisted by runtime;
- completion projections.

In multi-user Form mode, `activeUserId` must be explicit or the runtime must fail closed.
Do not silently select the first configured user for an execution surface.
```

```markdown
# Multi-user Form release contract

RTP-510 is the functional P0 gate.

Required real-browser evidence:

``​`text
User Alice:
  Alice field editable
  Bob field not editable

User Bob:
  Bob field editable
  Alice field not editable
``​`

Additionally:
- switch Alice -> Bob -> Alice preserves independent values;
- stale events from previous User are rejected;
- D1 and D2 do not contaminate;
- two Forms same JS realm do not share mutable state;
- two BrowserContexts are isolated;
- signature/initials/artifacts are isolated;
- touched/dirty/valid/completed observable and correct;
- sibling interactions do not rollback accepted values.

Unit tests alone cannot close this contract.
```

- **Líneas:** `31`
- **Tamaño original:** `0.5 KB`
- **SHA1 corto:** `bfc823ef3e`
- **Estado:** `completo`

```markdown
# Optimistic concurrency contract

El store no acepta una `revision` arbitraria como verdad del cliente.

Commit:

``​`ts
commit({
  expectedRevision,
  scope,
  schemaUid,
  value,
  executionId
})
``​`

Regla:

``​`text
storedRevision === expectedRevision
  -> accept
  -> store assigns next revision

otherwise
  -> explicit conflict
``​`

Shared values usan una identidad lógica compartida de documento/scope independiente de la
sesión efímera de cada Form.

El store expone cleanup por scope/document/instance.
```

```markdown
# Usuarios, ownership y color

## Regla central

``​`txt
LeftSidebar/futuros schemas → activeRecipientColor
schema existente            → stored ownerColor
schema recién creado         → activeRecipientColor persistido como ownerColor
``​`

Cambiar Alice→Bob→Carla no recolorea schemas existentes.

## Prioridad de color

1. schema.ownerColor
2. schema.userColor/recipientColor legacy
3. metadata `__designer`
4. recipient registry
5. fallback explícito

## Semantic color

Approve verde, Decline rojo, Note informativo, image/SVG/barcode/shape conservan
su contenido. El owner color se limita al chrome externo.

## Reasignar

Visible con `assignableRecipientCount > 1` y selección. Disabled con reason si
no hay permiso. Preserva geometry, routing, readOnly y locks.
```

```markdown
userId × documentId × sessionScopeKey

recrear el runtime; una actualización de input normal no debe remount.
```

```markdown
# Schema completion contract

type SchemaInteractionState = {
  schemaUid: string;
  schemaName: string;
  schemaType: string;
  userId?: string;
  documentId: string;
  runtimeSessionId: string;

  touched: boolean;

  initialValue: unknown;
  currentValue: unknown;

  lastOrigin:
    | 'user'

    | 'prefill'
    | 'restore'
    | 'migration'
    | 'system';

  lastTransactionId?: string;
};
``​`

Prohibido `Boolean(value)` como completion genérico.
```

### 0911 — `.ai/brain/20-contracts/runtime/SCHEMA-INTERACTION-INVARIANTS.md`

- **Lenguaje:** `markdown`
- **Líneas:** `12`
- **Tamaño original:** `0.7 KB`
- **SHA1 corto:** `55f3acce63`
- **Estado:** `completo`

```markdown
# Schema interaction invariants

1. A visible draft in schema A must survive any interaction with schema B.
2. Local runtime state is updated before host notification.
3. Multi-property schema changes are atomic.
4. `draft` and `commit` are different phases.
5. `touched`, `dirty`, `valid` and `completed` are different states.
6. Host synchronization cannot overwrite a newer local revision with an older echo.
7. `0`, `false`, `[]`, `null`, `undefined` and `""` are not interchangeable.
8. Schema behavior is declared through registry/manifest/codec, not duplicated switches.
9. User/document/session isolation applies to every schema family.
10. Form, Viewer, Snapshot and PDF must agree on normalized values.
```

### 0912 — `.ai/brain/20-contracts/runtime/SCHEMA-INTERACTION-ISOLATION.md`

- **Líneas:** `15`
- **Tamaño original:** `0.5 KB`
- **SHA1 corto:** `614aae4cd2`
- **Estado:** `completo`

```markdown
# Schema interaction isolation

Una interacción sobre schema B no puede revertir estado aceptado de schema A.

Claves:
- local-first;
- patch multi-key atómico;
- schemaUid estable;
- `origin + revision + transactionId` para reconcile;
- no reconstruir estado desde DOM;
- no usar truthiness para empty/equality;
- plugins no escriben storage de siblings directamente;
- dos Forms simultáneos no comparten mutable singleton state.

Gate obligatorio: pairwise interaction matrix además del test individual de cada schema.
```

- **Tamaño original:** `0.5 KB`
- **SHA1 corto:** `e89941718c`
- **Estado:** `completo`

```markdown
# Shared value conflict contract

Un assignment multiusuario debe declarar el scope del valor:

``​`ts
type SchemaValueScope = 'shared' | 'per-user';
``​`

`per-user`:
cada execution mantiene valor aislado.

`shared`:
cambios concurrentes usan revision/transaction.

Dos commits incompatibles sobre el mismo schema producen:

``​`ts
type SchemaValueConflict = {
  schemaUid: string;
  executions: string[];
  revisions: number[];
  values: unknown[];
};
``​`

Nunca resolver por last-write accidental sin policy explícita.
```

```markdown
# User assignment contract

A schema assignment answers: **which SISAD-PDFME user(s) may/should interact with this schema?**

Canonical fields:

``​`ts
type AssignmentMode = 'unassigned' | 'single' | 'multiple' | 'shared';

type SchemaUserAssignment = {
  mode: AssignmentMode;
  assignedUserId?: string | null;
  assignedUserIds?: string[];
};
``​`

Canonical assignment index:

``​`text
userId
  -> documentId
      -> pageNumber
          -> schemaUid[]
``​`

Do not add a second host-actor dimension below `userId`.

Audit identity is separate:
- `createdByUserId`
- `lastModifiedByUserId`
- `lockedByUserId`

Historical `ownerRecipientId`, `ownerRecipientIds` and `recipientId` shapes are
not part of the current core contract. Inputs using them are rejected; current
state uses the canonical assignment representation only.
```

```markdown
# Signature adoption contract

Separate three axes:

1. identity:
   - fullName;
   - initials.

2. adoption style:
   - styleId;
   - fontKey;
   - visual recipe.

3. acquisition/execution method:
   - styled;
   - draw;
   - upload;
   - certificate/P12;
   - provider.

`allowedMethods` is not the same thing as the currently selected method.

Provider/certificate metadata is shown only when applicable.

Signature and initials may share the adoption style but produce separate artifacts.

Changing the current profile style does not mutate a previously adopted artifact.

External OneShot-like flows are SignatureProvider implementations, not hardcoded branches.
```

```markdown
# Signature contract

`draw`, `image` y P12/local son capacidades nativas/reutilizables. Providers externos implementan un contrato genérico. Secretos/credenciales nunca entran en schema, config JSON o snapshot. La firma digital PDF real no debe simularse con una imagen.
```

```markdown
# Consolidation objective memory

Durable objective:

SISAD-PDFME must become a portable, config-driven PDF Designer/Form/Viewer/Generator with
reliable multi-user isolation, complete schema behavior, provider-neutral integrations and
production evidence.

Key blocker observed during the latest campaign:
multi-user Form assignment/access propagation must be proven in browser. A `single` owner
assignment is not correct if another User remains editable.

Do not mark this resolved from a unit test alone.
```

```markdown
# Execution orchestration memory

Durable facts:

- User es la identidad reusable de interacción.
- Mutable state: RuntimeSession × User × Document.
- Sequential/parallel/mixed/massive son execution shapes, no Form modes.
- Completion es proyección, no truthiness.
- Shared values requieren conflict/revision policy.
- Sequential/parallel unification prefiere canonical data merge + regeneration.
- Massive produce resultados por execution; bundle es explícito.
- No conocimiento de un host concreto en Brain/core.
```

```markdown
# Portable host runtime

## Durable invariant

SISAD-PDFME receives a resolved execution context; it does not compute the consuming
application's business workflow.

Canonical isolation:

``​`text
runtimeSession × user × document
``​`

Canonical host boundary:

``​`text
consumer domain
→ consumer-owned adapter
→ User / Document / Inputs / Access / Resources / SignatureContext / opaque scope
→ SISAD-PDFME
``​`

When a requirement is discovered in a consumer, first ask whether it is a generic reusable
capability. Only the generic contract is allowed to enter this repository.
```

```markdown
# Memory topic — Runtime Platform

Durable decisions: local-first Form; manifest incremental; canonical codecs; PDF resource
lifecycle explicit; public host boundaries; registry-driven tests; identity SISAD-PDFME.

<!-- runtime-execution:memory:start -->
## Execution orchestration

- execution state se aísla por RuntimeSession × User × Document;
- execution shapes no son Form modes;
- completion es proyección;
- parallel shared values requieren conflict policy;
- canonical merge + generator es preferido para un documento lógico;
- massive produce resultado por execution y bundle sólo explícito.
<!-- runtime-execution:memory:end -->

<!-- autonomous-runtime:memory:start -->
## Production hardening

- configuration compiles to immutable resolved state;
- capabilities fail closed;
- grid/snap share page-space geometry;
- plugin registry owns schema runtime metadata;
- shared writes use optimistic concurrency;
- conflicts block canonical publication;
- legacy cleanup is evidence-driven;
- autonomous coordinator continues until final queue closeout.
<!-- autonomous-runtime:memory:end -->
```

### 0931 — `.ai/brain/70-memory/topics/tooling-architecture.md`

- **Lenguaje:** `markdown`
- **Líneas:** `11`
- **Tamaño original:** `0.4 KB`
- **SHA1 corto:** `7db6e15806`
- **Estado:** `completo`

```markdown
# Memory — tooling architecture

Durable decisions:

- stable semantic paths; no version suffixes/folders;
- one config authority under `config/tooling`;
- one Markdown/index/topology engine;
- hot-state files protected during imports;
- external backups instead of backup folders inside the repository;
- generated indexes are rebuilt, not copied from overlays;
- duplicate implementation paths become wrappers, then are removed after consumers migrate.
```

```markdown
# PRT-000 — Establish consumer-agnostic boundary baseline

## Objective

Audit canonical docs and source for concrete-consumer coupling. Remove/replace canonical
consumer-specific context, establish generic host contracts, and classify residual source
names as compatibility debt without a global rename.

## Product boundary

SISAD-PDFME reusable. No concrete consumer business semantics.

## Acceptance

- canonical Brain/routes/skills contain no concrete consumer semantics;
- source residue is enumerated and classified;
- no product code is changed merely to satisfy naming;
- architecture verification and link checks pass.

## Required process

1. reconcile live source/evidence/task dependencies;
2. characterize first divergence;
3. implement the smallest correct authority;
4. execute focal/integration/browser gates appropriate to risk;
5. write evidence;
6. update status only from executed facts.

## Safety

No destructive Git. No blanket stash. No force push. No worktrees for this project.
One writer per overlapping file set. Only the integrator stages/commits/pushes.
```

```markdown
# PRT-130 — Render SVG schemas into the PDF

## Objective

Replace the reflective `page.drawSvg` probe with a real renderer built on the PDF API
that actually exists, so an `svg` schema appears in the generated document instead of
silently disappearing.

## Product boundary

SISAD-PDFME reusable. No concrete consumer business semantics.

## Characterized divergence

`pdf-lib@1.17.1` does not implement `PDFPage.drawSvg`. Its drawing surface is
`drawText, drawImage, drawPage, drawSvgPath, drawLine, drawRectangle, drawSquare,
drawEllipse, drawCircle` — verified against the installed package. The plugin probed
for `drawSvg` at runtime and returned when absent, so every `svg` schema was a no-op:
the PDF generated without the graphic and without any error.

An interim replacement extracted `<path d>` with a regular expression and scaled by a
hardcoded `488/600` — the dimensions of the plugin's own default icon. That renders any
other SVG at the wrong size and ignores `viewBox`, nested `transform` and paint
inheritance.

## Decision

`drawSvgPath` is the real capability: it draws one path in raw SVG coordinates and
always concatenates `translate(x,y) rotate scale(1,-1)`. The renderer therefore emits,
per shape, its own CTM pre-multiplied by that same flip, so the composed matrix is
exactly the intended SVG→PDF mapping.

Supported subset: `svg`, `g`, `path`, `rect`, `line`, `polyline`, `polygon`, `circle`,
`ellipse`; `viewBox` / `width` / `height`; `preserveAspectRatio` `meet` and `none`;
`transform` (`matrix`, `translate`, `scale`, `rotate`, `skewX`, `skewY`); inherited
`fill`, `stroke`, `stroke-width`, `opacity`, `fill-opacity`, `stroke-opacity`, and the
`style` attribute. Anything else raises `SvgRenderError`.

## Acceptance

- [x] no reflective probe and no silent no-op;
- [x] the real PDF API is characterized and used;
- [x] the drawing respects the schema box, `viewBox` and nested transforms;
- [x] an undrawable document fails loudly;
- [x] a PDF test proves the geometry reaches the page.

## Export classification

- `SvgRenderError` — **PUBLIC_API**. A host generating PDFs from templates of unknown
  origin needs to tell an unsupported SVG apart from any other generation failure.
  Exported from `@sisad-pdfme/schemas`, which is a knip entrypoint.
- `planSvgDraw`, `parseSvgTransform`, `buildSvgViewportMatrix`, `svgShapeToPathData`,
  `multiplySvgMatrix`, `toDrawSvgPathMatrix`, `buildPivotRotationMatrix`,
  `parseSvgViewBox`, `parseSvgLength`, `IDENTITY_MATRIX`, `SVG_SHAPE_TAGS` — **INTERNAL**
  to the renderer pair, consumed across the two modules.
- `parseSvgMarkup`, `parseSvgNumberList` — **INTERNAL**, single-module; not exported.
- applying a matrix to a point was **TEST_ONLY** and lives in the test, not the source.

## Evidence

Source:

- `src/sisad-pdfme/schemas/graphics/svgGeometry.ts` — matrices, transform parsing,
  viewport fit, shape→path conversion;
- `src/sisad-pdfme/schemas/graphics/svgRenderPlan.ts` — XML parser, paint inheritance,
  draw plan, `SvgRenderError`;
- `src/sisad-pdfme/schemas/graphics/svg.ts` — emits the operators via
  `pushGraphicsState` / `concatTransformationMatrix` / `drawSvgPath`.

Executed:

- `npx vitest run tests/unit/contracts/schemas/svgPdfRendering.test.ts`
  → 16 passed. Asserts geometry operators (`cm`, `m`/`l`, `f`, `rg`) in the content
  stream of the saved-and-reloaded PDF, the viewBox→box mapping, the composition of a
  group `transform`, paint inheritance, and five fail-closed paths.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` → clean.

## Known limits

`fill-rule="evenodd"`, `<text>`, `<image>`, `<use>`, `<defs>`, `<style>`, gradients,
clip paths and masks are rejected rather than approximated. Widening the subset is a
new slice, not a silent fallback.

## Safety

No destructive Git. No blanket stash. No force push. No worktrees for this project.
One writer per overlapping file set. Only the integrator stages/commits/pushes.
```

```markdown
# PRT-140 — Select chevron parity across Designer, Form and Viewer

## Objective

Characterize the `select` schema chevron on the three UI surfaces and restore the
behavior its own contract describes.

## Product boundary

SISAD-PDFME reusable. No concrete consumer business semantics.

## Characterized divergence

The condition read `shouldShowChevron = mode !== 'form'` while the comment above it
stated the chevron is *"shown in every UI mode so the field always reads as a
dropdown"*. The two contradicted each other, and the code hid the chevron precisely on
the surface where the user opens the dropdown.

Two facts confirm it is a regression, not a decision:

- the previous condition was `mode !== 'pdf'`, and `Mode` is `'viewer' | 'form' |
  'designer'` — there is no `'pdf'` member, so the original expression was always true
  and the chevron rendered on all three surfaces;
- the container still reserves `padding-right: 22px` **only** in form mode, exactly the
  chevron width, which left a permanent empty gutter next to every select.

The rule that *is* mode-specific is a different one: the interactive native `<select>`
overlay must mount only in form, because in designer it would capture pointer events
and block drag, selection and Moveable.

## Decision

The chevron is decorative (`pointer-events: none`) and renders on all three UI
surfaces; `ui` never runs during PDF generation, so there is no mode to exclude. The
width and the reserved gutter now come from a single `CHEVRON_SLOT_PX` constant, so
they cannot drift apart again. The native overlay keeps its `mode === 'form' &&
!schema.readOnly` guard.

## Acceptance

- [x] characterization test covering Designer, Form and Viewer;
- [x] chevron present on the three surfaces, including read-only fields;
- [x] chevron never captures pointer events;
- [x] native `<select>` still exclusive to form;
- [x] reserved gutter and chevron width share one source.

## Evidence

Source: `src/sisad-pdfme/schemas/select/index.ts` — `appendSelectChevron`,
`CHEVRON_SLOT_PX`.

Executed:

- `npx vitest run tests/unit/contracts/schemas/selectChevronSurfaces.test.ts`
  → 8 passed. Before the fix the same file reported 5 failures, all of them the missing
  chevron in form mode; that failing run is the characterization of record.
- `npx vitest run tests/unit/contracts/schemas` → 986 passed.

## Note for the concurrent writer

The same file arrived at `const schema: Plugin<Schema>` with no `Schema` import, which
broke `tsc`. Restored to `Plugin<Select>`, matching `createSchemaPlugin<Select>`. If the
PropPanel typing slice intends a different declaration type, it must import the symbol
it uses.

## Safety

No destructive Git. No blanket stash. No force push. No worktrees for this project.
One writer per overlapping file set. Only the integrator stages/commits/pushes.
```

```markdown
# PRT-150 — Migrate the one unique capability of the deleted host bundle

## Objective

Compare the capabilities removed with `src/examples/hostBundle.js` against the current
productive API, keep the delete, and migrate under a productive name only what has no
equivalent.

## Product boundary

SISAD-PDFME reusable. No concrete consumer business semantics.

## Capability comparison

Source of truth for the deleted file: `git show ca19d280^:src/examples/hostBundle.js`.

| Removed capability | Productive equivalent | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `normalizeHostData` | `integration/normalizeHostData.ts`. The example only added lab collaboration decoration; its `activeRecipientId` fallback already exists productively (`activeRecipientId ?? recipients[0]?.id ?? ''`). | delete stands |
| `buildBundle` | `createSisadPdfmeInstanceBundle` + `serializeSisadPdfmeInstanceBundle`. Different shape, same capability, and the productive one additionally strips secrets — which the example did not. | delete stands |
| `buildHref` | `serializeSisadPdfmeInstanceBundle` + `encodeURIComponent`. A transport convenience of two lines, not a capability. | delete stands |
| `createTemplate`, `appendTemplatePages`, `createUploadedDocument`, `createCollaboration`, `create`, `clone` | Lab scenario construction. | delete stands |
| **inline `basePdf` (recursive, incl. uploaded documents)** | **none** | **migrated** |

## Characterized divergence

`createSisadPdfmeInstanceBundle` produces a *clean* bundle but leaves `basePdf` exactly
as the host handed it over. A bundle exported with `basePdf: 'https://…'` cannot be
restored anywhere else.

Worse, `stripSecrets` rebuilds every object from its enumerable keys, so a binary
`basePdf` survives as `{ "0": 37, "1": 80, … }` — unrecoverable once inside the bundle.
Inlining therefore has to happen *before* the bundle is assembled, not after: once the
value is a string it crosses the secret sweep intact. Both halves of that ordering are
pinned by tests.

## Decision

`inlineSisadPdfmeInstanceAssets` converts every reachable `basePdf` — template, template
map and documents, in both `definition` and `resources` — to a base64 data URI.
`createPortableSisadPdfmeInstanceBundle` composes it with the existing builder and
stamps `assetEncoding: 'base64-inline'`, which `isInlinedSisadPdfmeInstanceBundle`
reads back. Download failures propagate; a bundle missing its base PDF is
indistinguishable from a whole one once serialized.

## Acceptance

- [x] capability comparison recorded against the productive API;
- [x] the delete stands for every capability with an equivalent;
- [x] the unique capability lives under a productive name, not as a restored example;
- [x] contract tests cover inlining, traversal, ordering and fail-closed;
- [ ] exported from the `integration` facade — **blocked**, see below.

## Evidence

Source: `src/sisad-pdfme/integration/instanceBundleAssets.ts`.

Executed:

- `npx vitest run tests/unit/contracts/integration/instanceBundleAssets.test.ts tests/unit/contracts/schemas/svgPdfRendering.test.ts tests/unit/contracts/schemas/selectChevronSurfaces.test.ts`
  → 35 passed (11 bundle, 16 SVG, 8 select).
- `npx tsc --noEmit` → clean.

## Blocked: facade export

`src/sisad-pdfme/integration/index.ts` is held under a write claim by `copilot`
(RTP-545) in `.ai/ops/coordination/claims.json`, and one writer per overlapping file
set is the rule. The capability is complete and tested but not yet reachable from the
public facade, so this card stays PARTIAL.

Remaining step, for whoever holds the claim next:

``​`ts
export {
  createPortableSisadPdfmeInstanceBundle,
  inlineSisadPdfmeInstanceAssets,
  isInlinedSisadPdfmeInstanceBundle,
  SISAD_PDFME_BUNDLE_ASSET_ENCODING,
} from '@sisad-pdfme/integration/instanceBundleAssets';
export type {
  SisadPdfmeInlinedInstanceBundle,
  SisadPdfmeInstanceBundleAssetOptions,
} from '@sisad-pdfme/integration/instanceBundleAssets';
``​`

Then add the public-import test and the consumer smoke required for a PUBLIC_API
capability, and move this card to PASS.

## Ratchet

`npm run quality -- dead-exports:ratchet` reports `317 > 316`. The whole delta is this module:
knip lists `src/sisad-pdfme/integration/instanceBundleAssets.ts` as an unused file
precisely because the facade export is blocked above. The baseline was **not** updated —
the surface grew for a coordination reason with a named owner and a defined next step,
which is exactly the case the ratchet exists to surface. It returns to green with the
export, not with a new number.

## Safety

No destructive Git. No blanket stash. No force push. No worktrees for this project.
One writer per overlapping file set. Only the integrator stages/commits/pushes.
```

```markdown
# Evidence — Form access and snapshot input fix

Date: 2026-08-14

## Root cause

`resolveRuntimeSchemaAccess()` treated ownerless schemas as visible but not
editable in `form`. `Preview` then projected `readOnly: true` into the
renderer. The snapshot builder also treated `getInputFromTemplate()` results
as `{ name, value }` records instead of objects keyed by schema name.

## Changes

- Ownerless schemas are editable in normal Form mode.
- Locked and explicit readonly precedence is preserved.
- Viewer/PDF remain readonly.
- Global Form view remains readonly.
- Snapshot values are written under their real schema names and preserve `0`,
  `false`, and empty strings.
- Added resolver, builder, and Playwright interaction coverage.

## Validation

- Resolver and builder focal tests: PASS, 8 tests.
- Runtime suite: PASS, 64 tests.
- Schema suite: PASS, 98 tests.
- DigitalAgreements Form contract: PASS, 2 tests.
- Playwright navigation and Form/Viewer interaction: PASS, 2 tests.
- Build: PASS.
- Focal `git diff --check`: PASS.

## Scope

Only the central access policy, generic snapshot builder, and their tests were
changed. No DigitalAgreements business logic, backend, Form component,
Viewer component, schema renderer, or PDF generator was modified.
```

```markdown
# Form all-schema interaction hardening — partial evidence

- Repository: `/Users/desarrollo1/Documents/proyectos de Taylor/frontend/prueba-plugin`
- Branch: `main`
- HEAD at audit start: `a626c70d50dcd363d9b528302229f3ae2c217f8f`
- Date: 2026-08-13
- Status: `PARTIAL`

## Confirmed changes

### Number

`src/sisad-pdfme/schemas/number/index.ts` no longer delegates blindly to the
text renderer. It keeps the public string transport while separating an
in-progress draft from the canonical committed value. The contract covers
zero, negatives, decimal comma/dot, clear, invalid drafts, precision and
configured minimum/maximum.

### Option groups

`src/sisad-pdfme/schemas/options/optionGroupRenderer.ts` no longer applies the
Designer double-click timing workaround to Form clicks. Every Form activation
commits one atomic selection patch. Designer timing remains unchanged.

### Tables

`src/sisad-pdfme/schemas/tables/uiRender.ts` moved head/body editing positions
from module singletons to `WeakMap<HTMLDivElement, TableEditingState>`.
Resetting one table instance cannot reset another instance's editing position.

### Draw signature

`src/sisad-pdfme/schemas/signature/index.ts` now captures the pointer and handles
`pointercancel`/release. This closes the confirmed pointer lifecycle gap for
draw mode. P12/provider execution remains blocked on the generic provider
execution contract; no business provider was added to the core.

### Interaction projection

`src/sisad-pdfme/ui/Form.tsx` now exposes read-only
`getSchemaInteractionStates()` and page/name lookup methods. States are
initialized from the template and updated through the existing host/user input
callbacks, preserving the public string transport and distinguishing host
pushes from user interaction.

## Tests

| Command | Result | Meaning |
|---|---:|---|
| `npx vitest run .../numberInput.test.ts` | 18 passed | Number draft/commit contract |
| `npx vitest run .../optionGroupIsolation.test.ts` | 2 passed | Rapid Form clicks and group isolation |
| `npx vitest run .../tableEditingIsolation.test.ts` | 1 passed | Table state isolation |
| `npx vitest run .../signatureInteractionContract.test.ts` | 4 passed | Mode and pointer lifecycle contract |
| `npx vitest run .../runtime .../form` | 64 passed | Runtime/Form regression suite |
| `npx vitest run .../formInteractionState.test.ts` | 2 passed | Host/user and zero/false projection contract |
| `npm run test:e2e -- tests/test-form-navigation.spec.ts` | 2 passed | Form interaction and Viewer readonly smoke |
| `npm run build` | PASS | Production bundle compiles |
| focal `git diff --check` | PASS | Own slice has no whitespace errors |
| focal `eslint` | 0 errors | Product schema paths are ignored by global config; no lint errors in test files |

## Not closed

The following acceptance items remain unresolved and prevent claiming “Form
completo” or marking the RTP cards done:

- registry-derived stress harness with multiple instances of every schema;
- pairwise integration matrix across all families;
- generic serializable P12/provider execution resource;
- multi-user, multi-document and runtime-session BrowserContext tests;
- all-schema Playwright gate and no-console-errors gate;
- snapshot/PDF/generator parity for every family.

These are actionable follow-ups for `RTP-095`, `RTP-130`,
`RTP-210`, `RTP-220`, `RTP-225`, `RTP-270`, `RTP-310` and `RTP-315`, subject
to their live dependencies. `RTP-310` must not start before its dependencies
are genuinely closed.

## Latest schema isolation and registry smoke slice

- `schemaBuilder` dedupe is now scoped by `rootElement` before falling back to
  the legacy non-DOM cache. Equal schema ids in separate runtime roots no
  longer suppress each other's first emission.
- Checkbox Designer double-click timestamps are scoped by root; Form does not
  use that timing path.
- Barcode rendering uses `toCanvas` when the browser export provides it and
  falls back to `toBuffer` for SSR/test resolution. The fallback removes the
  captured `bwip-js` console error without changing the public schema value.
- Registry smoke coverage is generated from `getBuiltInFields()` and mounts
  every registered schema in `designer`, `form`, and `viewer`: `117/117`.
- The smoke test supplies the required theme contract and asserts no
  `console.error` during mount.

Latest focused results:

| Command | Result |
|---|---:|
| `npm run test:sisad-pdfme:schemas` | 245 passed |
| `npm run test:sisad-pdfme:runtime` | 66 passed |
| registry mode smoke | 117 passed |
| schemaBuilder/checkbox isolation | 5 passed |
| `npm run test:e2e -- tests/test-form-navigation.spec.ts` | 2 passed |
| `npm run build` | PASS |
| `git diff --check` | PASS |

## Form sibling preservation

`Form.setInputs()` now merges each incoming row with the current row before
delegating to `PreviewUI`. This prevents a controlled host update containing
only schema B from clearing schema A. Explicit empty values still clear the
named schema. The shared `usePdfmeRuntimeInstance` adapter was intentionally
left unchanged because its existing contract treats omitted keys as removal.

Focused contract: `formInteractionState.test.ts`, 4 passed.

## Worktree attribution

The worktree contains unrelated dirty files and prior session changes. This
slice owns the schemaBuilder, checkbox, barcode helper and registry smoke
changes listed above, plus their focused tests; earlier number, option-group,
table, signature and Form tracking changes remain separately attributable.
No unrelated files were reverted or normalized.
```

### 0984 — `reports/runtime-platform/evidence/details/RTP-510-multiuser-wiring.md`

- **Lenguaje:** `markdown`
- **Líneas:** `297`
- **Tamaño original:** `10.7 KB`
- **SHA1 corto:** `fd441c8d96`
- **Estado:** `completo`

```markdown
> Detalle de una pasada anterior, no la evidencia canónica de la task.
> El estado vigente de RTP-510 vive en `../RTP-510.md`; este archivo se
> conserva por su diagnóstico, ya superado.

# RTP-510 — Aislamiento per-user: causa raíz localizada

## Qué se construyó

Ruta nueva `/runtime/form/multi-user` (`runtime-form-multi-user`), que usa el
builder `multiUserShowcase`. Ese builder **ya reparte ownership per-user**:
asigna `ownerRecipientId`, `ownerRecipientIds`, `ownerRecipientName` y
`ownerMode: 'single'` en round-robin sobre los schemas.

Es decir: la plantilla con asignaciones per-user ya no falta.

## Qué se midió en navegador

``​`text
alice → text-0, number-1, company-4 : contentEditable = true
bob   → text-0, number-1, company-4 : contentEditable = true
alice escribe "DE-ALICE" → bob ve "DE-ALICE"
``​`

Ningún campo queda bloqueado para el usuario no asignado. El aislamiento
per-user **no se aplica**.

## Causa raíz

No es que falte la capacidad. `Preview.tsx` —el renderer del Form— ya la
implementa:

``​`ts
const access = accessCtx
  ? resolveRuntimeSchemaAccess(schema, isForm ? 'form' : 'viewer', accessCtx)
  : null;
const lockedByAccess = Boolean(access && !access.editable);
``​`

El problema es que `accessCtx` se construye condicionalmente:

``​`ts
const collab = previewOptions?.collaboration;
const accessCtx =
  collab && (collab.activeRecipientId || collab.isGlobalView) ? { … } : undefined;
``​`

Exige `options.collaboration.activeRecipientId`. El lab, en cambio, declara en
el manifest:

``​`json
"collaboration": true
``​`

Un **booleano**, no un objeto. `hostBundle.js` hace
`collaboration ? cloneDeep(collaboration) : null` → `true`, y después lee
`source.collaboration?.users` y `source.collaboration?.activeUserId`, que sobre
un booleano son `undefined`.

Resultado: `accessCtx` queda `undefined` y `Preview` renderiza todos los
schemas como antes — que es literalmente lo que dice su comentario
(«Otherwise the form renders all schemas as before»).

El conmutador de usuario del lab escribe en `state.activeRecipientId`, que
viaja como recurso de instancia, **no** dentro de `options.collaboration`.

## Autoridad duplicada detectada

Existen dos resolutores de acceso:

| Módulo | Consumidores |
|---|---|
| `runtime/schemaAccess.ts` → `resolveSchemaAccess` | **cero** |
| `ui/collaboration/schemaRuntimeAccess.ts` → `resolveRuntimeSchemaAccess` | `Preview.tsx`, widgets del Designer, menú contextual |

El primero es la primitiva genérica con `assignment.mode`/`valueScope`; el
segundo es el que realmente gobierna el runtime y habla de `ownerRecipientId`.
Convergerlos es alcance de RTP-535, pero conviene decidirlo antes de cablear:
cablear el equivocado duplicaría la deuda.

## Dos ciclos de reparación agotados — BLOCKED

Se aplicó el límite de la campaña: máximo dos ciclos por hipótesis.

### Lo que SÍ quedó descartado

**La plantilla no es el problema.** Comprobado ejecutando el builder:

``​`text
buildMultiUserShowcaseTemplate(resolveFamilyGroups({familySource:'multiUser'}))
→ 28 schemas
→ text:alice  number:bob  fullName:carla  emailAddress:alice …
→ ownerMode: 'single' en todos
``​`

El ownership per-user está presente y bien repartido.

### Intento 1 — merge manual de `collaboration` en la config del lab

`RuntimePage` pasa ahora `collaborativeConfig` con
`collaboration: { enabled: true, activeRecipientId }`. Medición: sin efecto,
los tres campos siguen `contentEditable` para ambos Usuarios.

### Intento 2 — usar la API de overrides del propio lab

Sustituido el spread manual por
`createRuntimeConfig(profile, { collaboration: {…}, recipients: {…} })`, que es
la vía que hace deep-merge por perfil. Medición: sin efecto.

### Causa raíz AISLADA (tercer ciclo, bajo claim de coordinación)

Mis dos primeros intentos atacaban la palanca equivocada. `Preview` **no** lee
`runtimeOptions.collaboration`: `SisadPdfmePreviewRuntime` lo sobrescribe con
un valor calculado.

``​`ts
// react/SisadPdfmePreviewRuntime.tsx
options: {
  ...resolvedConfig.runtimeOptions,
  collaboration: collaborationOptions,   // ← override explícito
}
``​`

Y `collaborationOptions` se construye así:

``​`ts
// react/useSisadPdfmeRecipientRuntime.ts
const collaborationOptions =
  recipientFilterEnabled && !isGlobalView && effectiveActiveRecipientId
    ? { activeRecipientId: effectiveActiveRecipientId, isGlobalView }
    : { isGlobalView };                  // ← sin activeRecipientId

const effectiveActiveRecipientId = recipientRegistry.state.activeRecipientId;
``​`

Con `effectiveActiveRecipientId` vacío el objeto queda `{ isGlobalView: false }`.
Entonces, en `Preview`:

``​`ts
const accessCtx =
  collab && (collab.activeRecipientId || collab.isGlobalView) ? { … } : undefined;
``​`

`{ isGlobalView: false }` es un objeto truthy pero **no cumple ninguna de las
dos condiciones**, así que `accessCtx` queda `undefined` y el acceso por
Usuario no se evalúa en absoluto.

Eso explica la medición: todos los campos editables para ambos Usuarios.

**La lógica de decisión es correcta.** `resolveRuntimeSchemaAccess` ya exige
`isOwnerActive || isShared || noOwner` para que un schema sea visible; si
recibiera contexto, ocultaría los ajenos. El fallo está exclusivamente en que
nunca recibe contexto.

### Punto exacto a reparar

`recipientRegistry.state.activeRecipientId` está vacío en el Form. Hay que
determinar cuál de los dos es:

1. la prop `activeRecipientId` no llega a `SisadPdfmePreviewRuntime` desde
   `resources.activeRecipientId` de la instancia; o
2. llega, pero `useRecipientRegistry` no la adopta porque los `recipients` no
   se registraron.

Ambas se distinguen inspeccionando `recipientRegistry.state` en la ruta
`/runtime/form/multi-user`.

Corolario para quien retome: **la config no es la palanca**. Mis intentos 1 y 2
(merge de `collaboration` en la config del lab) eran incorrectos por diseño y
no deben repetirse. Se conservan porque pasar `collaboration` como objeto sigue
siendo más correcto que el booleano anterior, pero no arreglan esto.

### Cadena completa, para referencia

``​`text
config.collaboration.activeRecipientId
  → resolveSisadPdfmeConfig → runtimeOptions.collaboration
  → OptionsContext
  → Preview: previewOptions?.collaboration
  → accessCtx → resolveRuntimeSchemaAccess → readOnly
``​`

Se confirmó que `createRuntimeConfig` devuelve un `SisadPdfmeGlobalConfig` con
la forma correcta y que `resolveSisadPdfmeConfig` propaga
`collaboration` a `runtimeOptions`. El eslabón que falla está **entre
`resources.config` de la instancia y el `OptionsContext` que lee `Preview`**, y
no se ha aislado.

Siguiente paso concreto para quien retome: instrumentar `Preview.tsx` para
volcar `previewOptions?.collaboration` en la ruta `/runtime/form/multi-user` y
comparar con lo que entrega `resolveSisadPdfmeInstance`. Eso decide en un solo
paso si el problema es que `resources.config` no llega, o que llega y se pierde
la rama al construir `runtimeOptions`.

## Falta para PASS

1. Aislar el eslabón roto de propagación descrito arriba.
2. Decidir qué resolutor de acceso es la autoridad —`runtime/schemaAccess.ts`
   (cero consumidores) o `ui/collaboration/schemaRuntimeAccess.ts` (el que
   gobierna hoy)— y retirar el otro. Cablear el equivocado duplicaría la deuda.
3. Repetir la medición: con `ownerMode: 'single'`, el Usuario no asignado debe
   ver el campo como no editable.

## Lo que sí queda entregado

- ruta `/runtime/form/multi-user` con ownership per-user real;
- conmutador de Usuario activo en el Form;
- `collaboration` viaja ya como objeto y no como booleano;
- gate E2E de 19 pruebas sobre el Form, verde;
- suites sin regresión: E2E **46 PASS / 2 skipped**, `tsc` **148 = baseline**.


---

# Cuarto ciclo — causa raíz ENCONTRADA y corregida parcialmente

## La medición decisiva

Instrumentando el bucle de render de `Preview` (probe temporal, ya retirado):

``​`text
[{name:"text", owner:undefined, mode:undefined, editable:true, reason:"no-owner"},
 {name:"number", owner:undefined, ..., reason:"no-owner"}, …]
``​`

`reason: 'no-owner'`. El schema llega a `Preview` **sin** `ownerRecipientId`,
pese a que el builder del lab sí lo pone (medido: `text→alice`, `number→bob`).

Es decir: la lógica de acceso nunca fue el problema, ni el contexto de
colaboración —`hasAccessCtx: true` estaba confirmado—. **La plantilla perdía
los owners por el camino.**

## Causa raíz

`DEMO_DOCUMENTS` construye la plantilla de cada documento con
`buildShowcaseTemplate`, que **no** aplica ownership:

``​`js
export const DEMO_DOCUMENTS = Data.demoDocuments.map((document) => ({
  id, label,
  template: buildShowcaseTemplate(...),   // ← sin owners
}));
``​`

Y el core prefiere la plantilla del documento activo sobre la construida:

``​`ts
// integration/resolveSisadPdfmeInstance.ts
const resolveActiveDocumentTemplate = (documents, activeDocumentId, fallbackTemplate) => {
  const documentTemplate = documents.find(d => d.id === activeDocumentId)?.template;
  return documentTemplate ? documentTemplate : fallbackTemplate;
};
``​`

La ruta pasaba **las dos cosas**: la plantilla multiusuario con owners *y*
documentos demo cuya plantilla los pisaba. `activeDocumentId` cae por defecto
en `documents[0].id`, así que ganaba siempre el documento.

**No es un fallo del core.** El comportamiento de
`resolveActiveDocumentTemplate` es correcto: un documento con plantilla propia
debe mandar. El error estaba en la configuración de la ruta del lab.

## Corrección aplicada

`config.documents === false` → la ruta no recibe documentos demo. Declarado en
el manifest para `runtime-form-multi-user`.

### Efecto medido

Antes: los 28 schemas editables para cualquier Usuario.
Después: sólo se renderiza un subconjunto, y los campos de otros Usuarios
**desaparecen del DOM**. La regla `visibleByRecipient` ya actúa.

## Defecto residual: el filtro queda anclado al Usuario inicial

``​`text
alice → índices 0, 3, 6, 9, 12 …
bob   → índices 0, 3, 6, 9, 12 …   (idénticos)
carla → índices 0, 3, 6, 9, 12 …   (idénticos)
``​`

Con reparto round-robin sobre tres Usuarios, los índices 0/3/6/9/12 son
**los de alice**. El conmutador cambia `state.activeRecipientId` y la instancia
se reconstruye —`state.activeRecipientId` está en las dependencias del memo y
se pasa como recurso— pero el filtrado sigue usando el Usuario inicial.

El anclaje está por debajo, en la cadena
`activeRecipientId → useRecipientRegistry → state.activeRecipientId →
collaborationOptions`. Candidato principal: el registry compartido que llega
del Provider (`providerValue?.recipientRegistry`) no adopta el id controlado en
re-render, sólo en el montaje.

## Estado

De «el aislamiento no existe» a «el aislamiento funciona pero no sigue al
conmutador». Falta un solo eslabón, ya acotado.

Gates tras la corrección: E2E **54 PASS / 2 skipped**, `tsc` **147**.
```

```markdown
# RTP-530 — Hallazgo previo: `RegisteredUsersSelector` sin consumidores

> Sub-evidencia **superada**. Se conserva como registro del hallazgo, no como
> estado. RTP-525 cerró la decisión pendiente y el componente **ya fue
> retirado**; el desenlace está en
> `reports/runtime-platform/evidence/RTP-530.md`. No declara `status:` propio
> porque el estado agregado de la task no puede vivir en un detalle.

Registrado durante el gate funcional de RTP-510. En su momento no se retiró
porque la decisión correcta dependía de RTP-525.

## Hecho

`src/sisad-pdfme/ui/components/RegisteredUsersSelector.tsx` tiene **cero
consumidores** en `src/`. No está exportado en ningún barrel público
(`ui/index.ts`, `index.ts`, `integration/index.ts`). Sólo lo referencian el
registro de trazabilidad y dos specs E2E grabados con codegen.

Verificación:

``​`text
grep -rn "RegisteredUsersSelector" src/ | grep -v "RegisteredUsersSelector.tsx:"
→ (vacío)
``​`

Sondeo en navegador de `/designer/multi-user`:

``​`text
designer-activerecipient-select  → 0 nodos
designer-activerecipient-empty   → 0 nodos
``​`

Ni el selector ni su estado vacío se montan.

## Por qué NO es simplemente código muerto a borrar

El componente es la **única superficie** que permitía cambiar de usuario
activo. Su desaparición no es una limpieza: es una capability sin superficie.
Bloquea el gate multi-usuario de RTP-510, que no puede demostrar «User A no
contamina User B» sin forma de conmutar entre A y B.

Knip lo marcaría como export muerto, pero el contrato de campaña es explícito:
el análisis estático no autoriza por sí solo retirar registries o superficies
dinámicas. Aquí además señalaría el síntoma, no la causa.

## Lo que SÍ se deriva del source

La capability no está perdida: `SisadPdfmeController.setActiveRecipient` existe
y el registry de usuarios la respalda. El conmutador es **chrome del host**, no
del core reusable — coherente con la frontera que ya declara `AGENTS.md`.

Por tanto la salida correcta es retirar el componente y dejar el conmutador en
manos del host, documentándolo en el contrato público. Lo que queda pendiente
de RTP-525 es la migración de nomenclatura `Recipient` → `User` en esa API
antes de fijarla como superficie recomendada; retirar el componente ahora, con
el rename pendiente, obligaría a tocar el mismo contrato dos veces.

## Impacto registrado

- `tests/test-1.spec.ts` y `tests/test-1-stable.spec.ts` quedan en `fixme` con
  diagnóstico; fallaban ya antes de esta campaña.
- El gate multi-usuario de RTP-510 queda BLOCKED con dependencia explícita.

## Auditoría RTP-530 — 2026-08-14

`RegisteredUsersSelector` queda clasificado como `dead`: no tiene consumidores
en `src/`, no aparece en los barrels públicos y las únicas referencias eran
specs históricas de una UI que ya no se monta. La eliminación ya presente en el
working tree no se revierte.

`npm run quality:dead-files` reportó 70 archivos no usados. Ese resultado es una
señal de Knip, no una autorización de borrado: todavía falta clasificar cada
candidato como `dead`, `public-compat`, `dynamic-registry`, `generated`,
`test-only` o `unknown`, y establecer el conteo before/after del ratchet.

Estado factual: **BLOCKED**, con un candidato seguro clasificado y el resto
pendiente de revisión.
```

```markdown
# Documentación técnica — Runtime / Preview base

## Rol del bloque

Este bloque contiene la base visual y funcional usada por Preview/Form/Viewer en SISAD PDFME. Su propósito es convertir templates en páginas renderizables, montar schemas mediante plugins, controlar zoom/navegación y sincronizar inputs/persistencia/API/Form JSON cuando aplica.

## Fronteras importantes

- `AppContextProvider` publica contexto global: tema, labels, fuentes, plugins y opciones.
- `CtlBar` solo emite callbacks; no modifica template directamente.
- `Paper` calcula y estabiliza páginas, fondos y metadata DOM.
- `Renderer` aísla plugins imperativos dentro de un wrapper controlado por el canvas.
- `Preview` compone el runtime y aplica reglas de visibilidad/acceso antes de renderizar cada schema.
- `usePreviewRuntime` concentra cálculos dinámicos, prefill, persistencia, requests y emisión de eventos runtime.

## Reglas preservadas

- No se cambió comportamiento funcional.
- No se cambiaron nombres de componentes ni exports por defecto.
- No se agregó lógica de negocio del host.
- No se introdujeron z-index hacks ni acoplamientos a Moveable/Selecto fuera del renderer/canvas.

## Recomendaciones de QA

1. Validar Preview con 1/N páginas y 1/N inputs.
2. Validar zoom presets y menú de acciones en anchos `comfortable`, `compact` y `minimal`.
3. Validar staticSchema con basePdf blank.
4. Validar schemas readOnly con placeholders y dateSigned enlazado a signature.
5. Validar que plugins imperativos no acumulen DOM tras cambios de schema/value.
6. Validar persistencia/prefill/API del hook sin sobrescribir valores ya digitados por usuario.
```

```markdown
# Documentación técnica — ListView / Right Sidebar

## Responsabilidad general

El bloque `ListView` representa la lista lateral derecha de campos/schemas del diseñador. Su responsabilidad es presentar el inventario editable de campos, permitir búsqueda/filtro, selección, ordenamiento por drag and drop, edición masiva de nombres y acciones colaborativas como asignación de destinatario.

## Separación de responsabilidades

- `ListView.tsx`: orquesta filtros, bulk rename, eventos runtime y layout.
- `ListViewToolbar.tsx`: renderiza controles de búsqueda, filtro, acciones bulk y badges.
- `ListViewFooter.tsx`: renderiza commit/cancel en modo edición masiva.
- `SelectableSortableContainer.tsx`: integra dnd-kit, ordenamiento y selección local.
- `SelectableSortableItem.tsx`: conecta cada schema con `useSortable` y metadata colaborativa.
- `Item.tsx`: componente visual puro de fila.
- `ListViewDragOverlay.tsx`: preview flotante durante drag.

## Contratos importantes

- El drag handle vive en `Item` mediante `listeners`.
- El click de fila se maneja por un hit target dedicado.
- Las acciones de visibilidad/eliminación detienen propagación.
- La lista conserva `data-testid` usados por pruebas E2E.
- La colaboración puede filtrar schemas y tintar iconos/badges.
- El reordenamiento en vistas filtradas se fusiona con la lista completa sin reordenar elementos invisibles.

## Riesgos a vigilar

- Si cambia el criterio de `filterSchemasForCollaborationView`, revisar que bulk rename siga alineando nombres con `viewSchemas`.
- Si se agregan más filtros, `mergeVisibleOrder` debe seguir preservando elementos no visibles.
- Si se cambia la selección múltiple, coordinar `activeSchemaIds` externo con `selectedSchemas` local.
- Si se cambia el DOM del row, preservar `data-testid="right-sidebar-field-item"` y el drag handle.
```
